In render-stage.py set final media_type to MULTI_LAYER_IMAGE before selecting OPEN_EXR_MULTILAYER.
Print one RENDER_CALL_BEGIN marker immediately before each actual bpy.ops.render.render invocation.
In run-f05.mjs distinguish expectedRenderCalls from observedRenderCalls by counting the frozen begin marker.
Bind recovery, cost, audit and completion checks to observedRenderCalls.
Update only evidence-root paths and attempt cross-bindings required by the new immutable root.

No pixel, time, RSS, disk, process-count, renderer-count or render-call threshold change.
No source .blend, product binary, OCIO config, job manifest semantics, order or authority change.
No attempt-01 evidence mutation or same-ID repair.
expectedOutcome: The unchanged approved job passes the same F0.5 acceptance criteria with precise observed render-call receipts.
